basic_profile.bio: I am a 25-year-old software engineering student based in Austin, Texas. I've always been fascinated by technology and how it shapes our world. I spend most of my time diving into coding challenges and exploring new tech trends. I'm a night owl, so you'll often find me online during late hours, usually between 11 PM and 3 AM. Currently, I'm single and focusing on my studies and career. I enjoy discussing socio-political issues and have a penchant for following the latest reviews on sci-fi movies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been pursuing a degree in software engineering for the past two years. My knowledge primarily stems from academic courses, online coding bootcamps, and self-taught projects. I'm passionate about learning and often participate in MOOCs to expand my skills.
